summary: Immutep Limited filed a Form 6-K on October 29, 2026 (filed November 2, 2026) furnishing its Quarterly Activities Report and Appendix 4C for Q1 FY27, the standard ASX quarterly cash-flow and operational disclosure mapped to a US foreign-private-issuer current report. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation or advisor is referenced. Disclosures cover the TACTI-004 efti root-cause analysis, a new 200 L manufacturing run, a retargeted clinical focus on CPS 1 HNSCC and neoadjuvant STS, IMP761 prioritization, and A$48.50 million cash with runway into H1 CY28. No risk-arb angle.
